data.title: 斯卡哈 · 温泉湿身紧身衣独奏·「不死者也会热……这是你不知道的影之国秘密」
data.description: 【影之国秘汤·紫雾温泉】紫雾氤氲的露天温泉里，斯卡哈的紫色紧身衣被温泉水浸得半透，紧贴着湿漉漉的丰盈身段，撕开的布料边缘卷起。她斜倚在岩池边，长发漂散在水面，指尖在水下缓缓抚过最敏感的蕊心，赤瞳失神地半阖——「哈啊…… Practice 完后的、这种时刻……连不朽、都会觉得疲倦呢……」
data.location: 影之国秘汤紫雾露天温泉
data.action: 斜倚岩池湿身半透紧身衣撕口，水下手指自抚，赤瞳半阖失神
data.lighting: 紫雾温泉的幽暗水光与岩间灯笼暖光交映
data.camera: medium shot, misty onsen, wet torn bodysuit, sensual solo framing
data.promptProse: Reclining against the rock rim of a violet-misted open-air hot spring in the Land of Shadows, Scathach wears her purple bodysuit soaked to translucent sheerness with a torn seam curling at her chest, the wet fabric clinging to every saturated curve. Her long purple hair drifts across the steaming water as one hand glides beneath the surface between her thighs, fingertips stroking her most sensitive core while her crimson eyes fall half-lidded, murmuring that even immortality wearies on nights like this. Ambient steam and lantern glow in a sensual solo composition, cinematic lighting, mist, detailed onsen background.
